context_requirements: Expression of MTNR1A and/or MTNR1B on the target cell line
An active melatonin/G-protein signaling tone for an antagonist to block
A transcriptional output program coupled to melatonin receptor signaling in that lineage
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and not explained by vehicle or general toxicity
Evidence of MTNR1A/MTNR1B-dependent transcriptional response in a line with detectable receptor expression
